concerns.text: The plan estimates total wall‑clock time ≤ 5 h on a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU, ~7 GB RAM). Summing the stated per‑step runtimes (scVelo ≤ 45 min × 4 datasets = 180 min, 500‑permutation null ≈ 30 min × 4 datasets = 120 min, 500 bootstraps ≈ 45 min, plus power‑analysis simulation) yields > 5 h, likely exceeding the 6 h CI limit and memory budget. This makes the pipeline infeasible under the free‑compute constraints without further optimisation or reduction of permutation/bootstrapping workload.
